rule dac_gh_0035 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Package published from unexpected actor or fork - packages.publish anomalous actor"
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0035"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1195.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "packages.publish" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "package.create" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "package.version.publish" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
